# HZO_FerroelectricCapacitor

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A nonvolatile capacitor using hafnium zirconium oxide (HZO) as the ferroelectric material, capable of storing charge states persistently. Provides a scalable, CMOS-compatible nonvolatile memory element that supports charge-domain operations for in-network neuromorphic processing.
